opening: I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly.
I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint.
I have asthma or I've needed a bronchodilator inhaler before.

opening.text: I've come in because my heart races or beats irregularly. I'm quite short of breath, it's hard to breathe, and I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint. I also feel anxious. I suffer from chronic anxiety and have been diagnosed with depression. I have asthma or I've needed a bronchodilator inhaler before.
